### New
- **How to read the thread, in the workflow log** (#37): when a run works on a stored thread (`refs/pi/threads/<n>`), the log gets a collapsible group with the `git fetch` / `git log` / `git show` commands that read it. The job summary gets the same commands. This also happens when the run fails, times out, or ends on a question.
